meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 NanoClaw 代理组切换到本地 Ollama 模型运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想在本地运行 AI 代理并节省 API 费用
copy.tagline_en: Route NanoClaw agent group to local Ollama model
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run AI agents locally and cut API costs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将你的 NanoClaw 智能体组连接到本地运行的 Ollama 模型，而不是 Anthropic API。智能体将使用本地模型（如 Gemma 或 Qwen）来响应你的指令。
howto.when: 当你希望本地运行智能体、节省 API 费用或尝试开源模型时，按照技能步骤配置后，智能体组就会自动使用 Ollama 模型。

say.text: 帮我检查一下当前 Ollama 有哪些可用模型。
say.note: 技能会列出本地已拉取的模型列表。

say.text: 把智能体组 'my-agent' 切换到 Gemma 4 模型。
say.note: 技能会修改配置，使该组使用指定模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude routes your NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. The agent will use a local model (e.g., Gemma or Qwen) to respond to your instructions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run agents locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. After following the skill steps, the agent group automatically uses the Ollama model.

say_en.text: Check what Ollama models are available.
say_en.note: The skill lists locally pulled models.

say_en.text: Switch agent group 'my-agent' to Gemma 4 model.
say_en.note: The skill modifies config to use that model.
